summary: Created desk:apps:book; it shows guests newest first and saved “Mira” to desk:guestbook when submitted.

files.desk:apps:book:
app 'Guest Book'
task start()
set guests to []
when exists('desk:guestbook')
when read('desk:guestbook') is not ''
set guests to lines(read('desk:guestbook'))
done
done
give {guests: guests, typed: ''}
done
task key(s, k)
when k is 'enter'
when s.typed is not ''
add('desk:guestbook', s.typed)
add s.typed to s.guests
set s.typed to ''
done
or when count(k) is 1
set s.typed to edit_text(s.typed, k)
or when k is 'backspace'
set s.typed to edit_text(s.typed, k)
done
give s
done
task draw(s)
title('Guest Book')
show(1, 1, count(s.guests) & ' guests')
set row to 3
for each guest in slice(reverse(s.guests), 1, 20)
show(row, 1, guest)
set row to row + 1
done
show(23, 1, 'name: ' & s.typed)
help('Type name; Enter saves; Backspace edits')
done
